verdict.rationale: SolidJS is an open-source JS library distributed via npm/npx with full SSR/serverless support, meaning the entire runtime is embedded in the developer's own app and hosted on their own infrastructure — there is no proprietary SaaS backend to depend on. missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation or guide framing this as 'self-hosting', and no independent write-up confirming production self-hosted deployments beyond generic SSR support.
